draft.subject: The time you spend writing notes
draft.body:
Nadia,

Most behavioral health clinicians spend 90–120 minutes a day on documentation. Not because the notes are complicated — because the system makes them slow.

JotPsych writes structured notes from your session recording, checks them against 150+ payer rules, and surfaces the CPT and ICD codes that match what you documented. The note is done before you see the next patient.

It works with the EHR you have today. No migration, up in five minutes. When you're ready, it can replace the whole system — notes, billing, scheduling, e-prescribing, telehealth.

You tried it once. If the timing is better now, I can set up a clean trial.

Let me know.

Alex
JotPsych

--
